title: Compensation.
bodyText: The members of the commission shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for expenses, including travel expenses, necessary for the performance of their duties.
bodyHtml: [§369-4]  Compensation.  The members of the commission shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for expenses, including travel expenses, necessary for the performance of their duties. [L 2022, c 41, pt of §1]
